SELF-HOSTED REACT — one-time setup
===================================

index.html loads React from this vendor/ folder (same-origin) instead of a CDN.
Download the two pinned files into this folder, then upload the whole site.

From inside the deploy/ folder, run:

    mkdir -p vendor
    curl -L -o vendor/react.production.min.js \
      https://unpkg.com/react@18.3.1/umd/react.production.min.js
    curl -L -o vendor/react-dom.production.min.js \
      https://unpkg.com/react-dom@18.3.1/umd/react-dom.production.min.js

That's it. Upload index.html, .htaccess, and the vendor/ folder.

Verify (optional): open the site, DevTools > Network, reload. You should see
react.production.min.js and react-dom.production.min.js loading from your domain
(your server) — and NO requests to unpkg.com.

Note: until these two files exist on the server, the page still works but falls
back to loading React from unpkg.com. Once present, nothing loads off-site.
